name: 44515 · Youngstown, OH
findings: ZIP 44515 (Youngstown) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44515 (Youngstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
